model.title: Iran Human Rights, Internet Freedom, and Accountability Act of 2026
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. David McCormick (R-PA)

summary.text: The bill would impose sanctions and other measures aimed at promoting human rights and internet freedom in Iran, while establishing mechanisms to hold Iranian officials accountable for alleged abuses. It seeks to address internet censorship, support online privacy and access for Iranian citizens, and target individuals and entities responsible for human rights violations.
